reuse: Same Comfy graph (scheme A) for every I2V shot. Only change slots.start_image (= scene_lock_first_frame), slots.positive_action, slots.seed. Do not fork per shot. FLF2V not default.

start_image.preprocess: scripts/crop_check_i2v.py when source is square looklock
start_image.role: Scene-locked first frame: looklock still (≥1024 short side) cropped to 480×832 that already contains the Normandy symbol for this beat (ramp/door / blast / flag silhouette).

scene_lock_first_frame.note: Same physical slot as start_image; naming emphasizes scene lock before motion.

positive.r1_salute_default: The anthropomorphic cat soldier quickly raises her right paw to the brim of her helmet in a crisp military salute and holds the salute firmly; her chin lifts and she stares straight into the camera; her red neckerchief flutters strongly in the wind. Fixed camera, medium shot, same face, fur pattern and US Army uniform as the first frame.
positive.r2_salute_replicate: The anthropomorphic cat soldier quickly raises her right paw to the brim of her helmet in a crisp military salute and holds the salute firmly; her chin lifts and she stares straight into the camera; her red neckerchief flutters strongly in the wind. Fixed camera, medium shot, same face, fur pattern and US Army uniform as the first frame.
positive.r4_head_turn: The anthropomorphic cat soldier snaps her head up and turns to stare directly into the camera, ears perking forward; strong wind whips her red neckerchief and blows dust across the frame. Fixed camera, medium close-up, same face, fur pattern and US Army uniform as the first frame.
positive.b0_01_ramp_door_drop: The landing craft bow ramp suddenly drops open with a heavy slam; bright gray Normandy daylight floods the troop compartment; the upright bipedal anthropomorphic orange-and-white cat soldier in US olive-drab field kit braces and steps forward toward the open ramp. Fixed camera inside the Higgins boat looking out, medium-wide, same face, fur pattern and US Army uniform as the first frame; readable Normandy LCVP / ramp door symbol in frame.
positive.b0_01_blast_breach: A sharp beach obstacle blast erupts ahead in dust and smoke; the upright bipedal anthropomorphic orange-and-white cat soldier in US WWII field jacket ducks then surges forward through the clearing path on Omaha-like sand. Fixed camera, medium shot, same face, fur pattern and uniform as the first frame; clear Normandy beach / hedgehog / smoke symbol.
positive.b0_01_flag_silhouette: The upright bipedal anthropomorphic orange-and-white cat soldier plants a small US flag into the Normandy sand and holds the pose as a backlight silhouette; wind snaps the flag and her red neckerchief. Fixed camera, hero wide-to-medium, same face and fur as the first frame; unmistakable flag-planting Normandy silhouette.

forbid_usable_claim_without: G1+G2+G2m PASS and HUMAN_ACCEPTED (AUTO_QC_PASS alone is not a usable/public clip)

machine.rule: full-stack-aligned; no cross-machine handoff; winner runs entire pipeline locally
machine.label: either-winner-full-stack

adopted.reason: motion gate already calibrated with R1 max_mad=16.27

identity_shift_3.when: only if identity drifts; official 480p baseline

expression_shift_5_6.when: only if expression is lost and identity is stable

r3_cfg5_shift10.when: only after R1/R2 both fail G2m

audio.default: silent or generated 128 BPM sine-tick bed

S05.first_frame: S04 last frame or boat_ramp vertical crop; $OUTPUT_ROOT/i2v/S05_wade/start_480x832.png
S05.positive: Exactly one anthropomorphic orange-white cat soldier in US WWII Normandy gear. At frame 0 she drives her boot into the knee-deep surf and wades forward, water blasts up to her waist and the red neckerchief rips sideways in the wind. Handheld low tracking camera follows at her pace. Same face, fur pattern, helmet and red neckerchief as the first frame. Only one character, no extra soldiers, no text, no extra limbs.
S05.acceptance: 水花可见；身份不崩；围巾强风可读；非静帧

S06.positive: Exactly one anthropomorphic orange-white cat soldier in US WWII Normandy gear. At frame 0 she snaps her head toward the rising smoke column, drops her shoulder and presses low, ears flattening; thick smoke rolls across the beach and wind snaps her red neckerchief. Fixed medium close shot. Same face, fur pattern, helmet and red neckerchief as the first frame. Only one character, no extra soldiers, no text, no extra limbs.
S06.acceptance: 战场可读、非棚拍；回头/压低动作完成；身份不崩
S06.downgrade: static + smoke layer allowed when budget is compressed; label DOWNGRADED

Same face, fur pattern, helmet and red neckerchief as the first frame. Only one character, no extra soldiers, no text, no extra limbs.
